name: Herrera (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Herrera (a shield inscribed NATUS FERRO POPULUS on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Herrera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
